title: Database Systems Fundamentals
description: This course covers the basics of database systems, including data storage, retrieval, and management. It's designed for beginners who want to learn the fundamentals of database systems and how to work with them.

modules.title: Introduction to Databases
modules.summary: Learn the basics of database systems and how they differ from traditional data storage methods.

modules.title: Setting Up a Database Management System
modules.summary: Install and configure a database management system on Windows and macOS.

modules.title: Creating and Managing Tables
modules.summary: Learn how to create, modify, and delete tables in a database management system.

modules.title: Querying and Joining Data
modules.summary: Master the skills of querying and joining data from multiple tables in a database management system.

modules.title: Database Design and Schema
modules.summary: Learn how to design a database schema using entity-relationship diagrams.
